answer: Each agent identity is registered in the nadir state tree only after a TPM/SGX enclave produces a zero-knowledge attestation binding its code hash and hardware key; velvet is the consensus contract that verifies attestations and applies a quadratic bonding curve, O(N^2), to identities per operator. An attacker must provision distinct physical silicon and forge enclave measurements, while zephyr anchors keys and irreversibly slashes collateral on duplicate proofs.
